column7: 2026-11-06: On release/10.x, CI publishes straight from the branch whenever the version in package.json changes. Any code fix landing here must bump the patch version in the same change, otherwise it never ships (stated by user).

2026-11-06: Do not edit the version in package.json on the next branch. The release job derives the version from changesets and fails if anyone bumps it by hand (stated by user). This overrides the release/10.x rule about bumping the patch version, which applies only to that branch.

2026-11-06: Added '/' to SEPARATORS in index.js (aws/region -> awsRegion); in regex v-mode '/' must be escaped inside a class. Bumped to 10.0.1 per the publish rule. Working tree already had uncommitted unrelated changes (capitalizeAfterNumber default false) that I left untouched.
